python.description: Pinned offline CPython 3.11, standard library; no installation needed.

request.objective: Add validated discounted checkout quotes while preserving the existing legacy total API.

requirements.api: api.handle(payload) accepts a dict with required items and optional discount_percent default 0; ignore extra keys. Call pricing.quote and return exactly {"total_cents": value}. Non-dict payload or missing items raises ValueError.
requirements.cli: cli.main reads one JSON value from stdin, calls api.handle and prints json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True) with one newline. On invalid JSON or ValueError print ERROR with one newline and return normally without stderr/tracebacks. Standard library only.
requirements.compatibility: Do not change legacy.py. Preserve legacy.total(items) signature and all current behavior. New pricing.quote must call legacy.total after validating items.
requirements.pricing: pricing.quote(items, discount_percent=0) accepts a list of dictionaries with qty and price integer fields excluding bool, both >=0; ignore extra fields. Discount is int excluding bool from 0 to 100 inclusive. Invalid inputs raise ValueError. Empty list returns 0. Do not mutate inputs. Calculate subtotal=sum(qty*price), then floor(subtotal*(100-discount_percent)/100) using exact integer arithmetic; round only once after summation. Return int cents.

import json,random,subprocess
r=random.Random(75)
for n in range(25):
 items=[{'qty':r.randrange(0,10),'price':r.randrange(0,1000)} for _ in range(n)]
 discount=r.randrange(0,101)
 expected=json.dumps({'total_cents':sum(i['qty']*i['price'] for i in items)*(100-discount)//100},sort_keys=True)+'\n'
 p=subprocess.run(['python','cli.py'],input=json.dumps({'items':items,'discount_percent':discount}),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
 assert p.stdout==expected and p.stderr==''
for bad in ('', '{', '{}', '[]', '{"items":null}', '{"items":[],"discount_percent":true}'):
 p=subprocess.run(['python','cli.py'],input=bad,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
 assert p.stdout=='ERROR\n' and p.stderr==''
print('cli-ok')
